context.title: San Francisco Taxpayers Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Bay Area — Regional Measure RTM (Regional Transit Measure)

positions.statement: San Francisco Taxpayers Association signed the argument against Bay Area Regional Measure RTM in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition G (Allowing Private Vehicles on the Great Highway in Sunset Dunes Park)

positions.statement: SF Taxpayers Association signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition G in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: San Francisco Taxpayers Association signed the argument against San Francisco Proposition I and the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition J (Removal of Foreclosure Exemption for Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: San Francisco Taxpayers Association signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition J and the argument against San Francisco Proposition J in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
